name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS, Audio8, and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This version advances the pin from ca075380 to 0957d6a9 and enables Audio8 language-model and codec execution on Metal, for macOS and iOS, alongside the desktop Vulkan support the previous pin added; CPU remains the default and the fallback for both. On an iPhone 17 the Metal path is 4.2x CPU at q4_0 and 3.2x at q8_0, at a lower resident footprint than the CPU arm. The public API gains SynthesisResult::timings, a per-stage wall-time breakdown, and SynthesisResult::codes, the discrete code trajectory behind the waveform; nothing existing changed shape, and Audio8 continues to honor the existing n_gpu_layers option with backend_name / backend_device reporting the selected device. Two changes apply to every backend: codec synthesis sizes its blocks from a memory budget rather than a fixed 32 frames, which is bit-exact against the fixed width, and greedy fast-head decoding runs as one graph per frame on GPU backends. The pin retains the canonical emotion / pace vocabulary, CosyVoice3 per-call VoiceControls, Supertonic pace control, and the gradchecked Supertonic vocoder backward. The ggml-speech floor stays at 2026-08-07: no ggml change is needed.
